name: Force of Will / Force of Will 2

cooldown.binNote: The bin's live SyndraW cooldown array reads [12/11/10/9/8], one second lower at every rank than ddragon's and the wiki's [13 to 9]; reporting the wiki's number as stated.

values.binNote: The wiki tooltip also lists an extra squared term '(+ 1.14% AP)^2' on top of the linear formula; this is not reflected in SyndraW#PassiveBonusDamage's arithmetic (BaseDamage*0.12 + (0.02*ap)*0.01) and is omitted here as an apparent tooltip display artifact rather than a real second damage component.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins only after the recast/throw effect, not after the initial grab cast.
The initial grab cast does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade, but the recast (throw) does.
mechanics.quote:
The initial cast does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Detonating the ability manually does.

mechanics.claim: If Force of Will is not recast within its hold duration, Syndra automatically releases the grabbed unit or sphere without dealing the throw damage.
mechanics.quote: If the ability is not recast within the duration, '''Syndra''' will release the unit or ''Dark Sphere'' that she is holding.
